item.title: Custom Printed Soap Boxes
item.description: A bar of soap lifted from a shelf, the logo sharp and centred, the colour exactly right, the board firm and clean between the fingers. Before your customer has read a single ingredient, they have already decided this is a brand worth trusting. That split-second judgement is the work your packaging does, and it either earns your product its place or loses it.
